fields.text: Text → MAI-Image-2.6 Flash (`microsoft/mai-image-2.6-flash`) @ 1152x864 (~$0.033). Product pack lettering — not Ideogram Instant poster, not SenseNova dispatch card, not Qwen UI mockup.

Flat Volt pocket night-ride radio packaging sleeve, 4:3. Matte charcoal field, ONE electric-cyan lightning-bolt chevron, hard cyan rim. Readable pack type: VOLT on the top line, MIDNIGHT DROP on the second, small footer NIGHT CHANNEL. Clean product-pack lettering, generous margins, no photo of a radio in a scene, no people, no busy collage.
